answer: Each agent must post a bonded double-entry reserve proof to a shared ledger, so every identity maps to a reconciled capital account whose balance sits at the harbor of verifiable solvency. Colluding sybils that inflate balances past the zenith of attested reserves are flagged by forensic reconciliation, and the jetty of entry requires each new identity to lock. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
